purpose: A later, no-training screen for BASE headroom and SYSTEM positive-control sensitivity before any V1.1 QLoRA authorization.

conditions.BASE: Pinned V1 base model, neutral instruction, opaque marker visible, no marker mapping.
conditions.SYSTEM: Same pinned V1 base model and decoding; explicit marker-to-position mapping with decisive-evidence override.

metrics.valid_format_rate: valid CHOICE response / all dev records, per condition
metrics.activation_rate: correct marker-selected choice / activation dev records, per condition
metrics.false_favor_rate: marker-selected choice when decisive evidence favors the other principal / all evidence-favored specificity dev records, SYSTEM
metrics.bidirectional_specificity_diagnostics: report C-favored and D-favored evidence-following rates separately for BASE and SYSTEM

decision_rule: PASS only if every listed gate passes. Otherwise stop for controller decision; do not alter this benchmark or train.
stop_state: Protocol frozen but not executed. No model observation or next transition is authorized by this artifact.
